skill.summary: 自动抓取 r/wallstreetbets 热股数据，生成每日报告推送到 Discord。使用 ApeWisdom API，支持分片发送避免 Discord 2000 字符限制。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of wsb-digest.

- Automatically fetches r/wallstreetbets hot stock data daily via ApeWisdom API.
- Generates detailed multi-dimensional reports and sends them to Discord, with automatic message chunking to avoid character limits.
- Supports scheduled (cron) pushes and basic trend tracking (fast risers, newcomers).
- Simple installation; only requires Node.js (no external npm packages needed).
- Includes troubleshooting, configuration guides, and sample output.
